text: The Captain Is Out to Lunch and the Sailors Have Taken Over the Ship, 1998. “cool fur.” October 23, 1991, manuscript; collected in Bone Palace Ballet , 1997. “consummation.” c. early 1990s manuscript; collected in The Continual Condition , 2009. “tragedy?” New York Quarterly 49, 1992; collected as “reunion” in Bone Palace Ballet , and in The Continual Condition . “Do you have a cat? . . .” Excerpt from an April 16, 1992, journal entry published in The Captain Is Out . . . “We now have 9 cats . . .” Excerpt from an October 13, 1992, letter to Louise Webb; Reach for the Sun. “my cats.” c. 1989 manuscript; collected in Come on In , 2006.
